text:
maria: quick check — trying to spin up a new Dedicated pool and hit a quota/reservation error. gcloud shows two reservations tied to project redwood-prod that look stale. anyone own procurement/billing for that project? :wave:

alex: can you paste the gcloud output?

maria: ```
$ gcloud compute reservations list --project=redwood-prod --filter='labels:gpu'
NAME               ZONE               MACHINE_TYPE    STATUS
reserve-phi-01     us-central1-a      a2-highgpu-1g   IN_USE
orphan-res-2024    -                  -               SUSPENDED
```

jin: :eyes: weird — 'SUSPENDED' with no zone. procurement/finance probably left metadata after the migration. @finance-lead any idea which billing account charged orphan-res-2024 last?

finance-lead: digging now. early results: billing-acct-legacy shows reservation charges through 2024-09. filing a quick invoice lookup. give me 15.

sam: if we confirm it's unused we can delete it with:
```bash
gcloud compute reservations delete orphan-res-2024 --project=redwood-prod --quiet
```
but need owner perms and a billing ok from finance.

procurement-bot: created ticket PRC-4521 to reconcile orphan-res-2024 and link to billing migration. https://tickets.internal/PRC-4521

maria: thanks. can procurement own coordination? if proc confirms it's safe, i'll schedule the delete during a quiet window tonight (23:00 PT) to free quota for the dedicated pool.

jin: i'll stand by to run smoke after deletion and confirm pool create works.

finance-lead: confirmed: last charge is 2024-09-12, no recurring today. i'll mark as deprecated and post cost owner. attaching invoice id INV-98765 in the ticket.

procurement-lead: taking ownership. will update PRC-4521 with vendor contact and approvals. ping me if you need us to hold a soft-block until the delete.

sam: perfect — once procurement closes the ticket i'll run the delete and post logs here.

maria: :thumbsup: closing loop — target delete tonight 23:00 PT if no objections. thanks all.

ops-bot: automated note — reservation-orphan-check threshold exceeded (4/3). ticket PRC-4521 created.
